description: Mock-only readiness endpoint (not part of the real YT proxy surface): 200 {} when the process is up and, in PostgreSQL mode, the user store is reachable; 503 {} while storage is unavailable. Consumed by the Helm readinessProbe and the compose healthcheck so the UI only receives traffic once sessions can be validated.
Convenience alias the mock serves next to /version (same plain-text body). The real proxy exposes /service returning {version, start_time} instead; that endpoint stays unimplemented.
Driver command variant of identity lookup: {login, realm} for the authenticated caller. The UI uses GET /auth/whoami instead; the mock serves the command for SDK-style clients.
Permission probe against an explicit ACL; the mock always allows. The UI issues it only inside execute_batch, but the command is also dispatchable top-level.

Operations page listing. The mock returns an empty-but-valid result (operations: [], incomplete: false, empty counter maps, failed_jobs_count: 0 — shape per scheduler_commands.cpp:417-441) so the page renders an empty state instead of an error block.

Queries page capability probe. The mock returns an empty capability set (supported_features: {}, no access_control_objects/clusters — shape per query_commands.cpp:429-437) so the page renders without errors and advanced QT features stay hidden.
